messages:
Ravi K: Heads-up 1: we need final alignment on a dual-cloud private-offer + hardware rebate path. Goal: list on Azure + GCP marketplaces but keep HW and SI incentives off-list.
Dana L: quick ask 1: why off-list for HW/SI? partners want visibility on the listing.
Ravi K: main reason is procurement accounting. If we show dollar-off on listing it counts as discount for marketplace billing; partners prefer vouchers so they can book as co-marketing or integration spend.
Sofia M: propose two incentive instruments: 1) "integration voucher" ($50k SI services credit, trancheable over 6 months, vests as usage hits 25%/50%/100%) 2) "hardware rebate" ($15k voucher applied post-invoice, requires partner co-sell tag). Both explicitly excluded from commit floor.
Jon P: +1 on vesting schedule. Also recommend a small upfront marketplace discount (5%) for first 3 months to drive trials, then switch to voucher model on conversion.
Evan C: for metered->commit migrations we should offer a one-time conversion uplift: commit multiplier 1.1x for first renewal year (so commit counted at 10% premium for partner incentives). helps smooth conversion economics.
Dana L: legal flagged that voucher transferability needs clarity. don't let partners sell vouchers. set non-transferable and auditable redemption flow.
Ravi K: agreed. redemption via partner portal w/ invoice upload. marketplace-bot will log redemptions.
marketplace-bot: Draft offer artifacts uploaded: https://redwood.app/offers/drafts/dualcloud-private-vouchers-2112 (partners-only) :lock: 
Sofia M: timeline proposals: GA listing (Azure+GCP) Nov 6, partner co-announce Nov 10, SI enablement workshop Nov 3. That gives 1 week lead for joint PR and 3 days for SI dry-run.
Jon P: routing/UI: primary CTA = "Request Private Offer" w/ checkbox "Partner bundle" that opens partner lead flow. if partner bundle selected, pre-fill partner id so partner gets lead.
Evan C: metrics to track: voucher redemption rate, conversion rate from trial to commit, net-new ARR influenced by partner leads, and avg time-to-redemption.
Ravi K: renewal guardrail: 12-month price protection for customers who convert to commit in promo window, then 6-month step-up of +2% per quarter to baseline. also cap on voucher per-account: one integration voucher and one hardware rebate per account per 12 months.
Dana L: please add explicit language: "vouchers do not reduce committed spend in contract calculations" and "vouchers expire 12 months after issuance". Legal also wants audit trail for redemption.
Sofia M: I'll add copy for listing and partner-facing FAQ. Jon/Evan, can you validate routing + telemetry by Friday?
Jon P: yes, will validate.
Evan C: will add telemetry events and dashboards.
Ravi K: OK. Action items: Sofia draft listing + FAQ by Tue EOD; Jon implement partner lead flow by Thu; Evan instrument metrics by Thu; Legal to sign off on voucher T&Cs by Fri. Next sync Mon 9am PT. :calendar:
